name: digest-covers-modes
title: The release digest does not cover the mode definitions the runtime loads
description: Measured: build-release-manifest.mts computes sourceDigest over bin, src, installer, .pi, dove_pi.py, package.json and package-lock.json - and not modes, while work-mode.ts loads modes/<id>/MODE.md and capabilities/code-audit.ts reads modes/code-audit/catalog/typescript.json. So two releases with different mode definitions can carry the same digest, which is the release integrity claim
creator: aixi
